name: StartupTile

sources.title: Homepage — daily startup launch board; mixes Product Hunt API imports with direct listings; 'Submit-$1', 'Get Featured - $19', Sponsor links in nav
Pay page — Standard Listing $1.99 one-time, Featured 7-Days $19, Featured 30-Days $35 ('lifetime backlink'); form: name, email, startup URL, optional note; Dodo Payments checkout

requirements: Payment required — cheapest entry is $1.99 one-time for a standard listing
Only fields needed: full name, email, startup URL, optional note — the listing itself is just name + one-liner on a daily board
Featured tiers ($19/7d, $35/30d) add top-section placement and a 'lifetime backlink'
preparation: Startup URL and a one-line description
Name, email, payment method (Dodo Payments checkout)
workflow: Choose Standard ($1.99) or a Featured tier ($19/$35)
Fill name, email, startup URL, optional note
Proceed to Dodo Payments checkout; listing appears on the daily board after payment/review
watchFor: No free tier — even the standard listing costs $1.99
Most daily tiles are auto-imported from the Product Hunt API — a $1.99 listing buys a permanent archived page, not prominence
Featured placement is what actually shows above the fold
'Lifetime backlink' claim on featured tiers is marketing; check whether the link is dofollow if that matters
Single-operator side project (@v2s2c on Twitter) — low but real traffic expectations
countsAsLive: The startup appears as a tile on the startuptile.com daily board and retains an archived listing page
unknowns: Whether listings get individual permalink pages or only daily-board entries
Link type (dofollow/nofollow) and whether utm_source params are appended
Review/approval step after payment, if any
